# Legal Corner

> > Legal Corner provides regulatory compliance and business licensing services across West Bengal and India, specializing in FSSAI, drug licenses, PSARA, and industry-specific registrations.

Legal Corner offers comprehensive legal and regulatory compliance services for businesses in Kolkata and West Bengal, with expertise in food safety (FSSAI), pharmaceutical licensing (CDSCO, Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940), private security regulation (PSARA), and industry-specific licenses. The firm assists with registration, modification, and ongoing compliance for manufacturing, trading, and service businesses across multiple regulated sectors.

## Key Topics

- FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
- PSARA (Private Security Agencies Regulation Act, 2005)
- Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940
- CDSCO (Central Drugs Standard Control Organization)
- West Bengal regulatory compliance
- Kolkata business licensing
- GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices)
- Drug licenses and pharmaceutical regulation
- Shop and Establishment Registration
- APMC License
- Ministry of Home Affairs compliance
- Food safety licensing
- Medical device licensing
- AYUSH licenses
- Factory licensing
